verdict.rationale: Sentry ships Seer, an in-product AI debugging agent. Its Autofix feature finds root causes and generates suggested code fixes for errors and performance issues from the user's own Sentry data, which is directly AI-generated insight and suggestion inside the product. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Seer's output quality, evidence of AI insights beyond issue root-causing (e.g., dashboard or trend insights), and in-depth docs, since the evidence is mostly short marketing snippets; it is also a separately paid subscription.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Use Autofix to find root causes and generate suggested code fixes for errors and performance issues
Automatically root-cause any issue... Catch critical issues before you merge and fix them when they hit prod with Seer, our debugging agent and code reviewer
